title: Crashlooping pod: missing required config
description: api pod restarts every minute. The cause is only visible in the PREVIOUS container logs: a required environment variable is unset because the ConfigMap key was renamed.
prompt: The api pod in the shop namespace keeps restarting. What's wrong and how do I fix it?
